Ensure icon size is applied just to outer SVG (#458)

Due to changes in chrome (https://issues.chromium.org/issues/40409865),
width and height presentation attributes within nested SVGs are now
respected, which breaks icons styling in RWP. This fixes that by
ensuring that the styling that sets width and height on the outer icon
SVG _only_ applies to the outer SVG, allowing the inner SVG's
intrinsic/declared size to be respected properly.

Tested in latest chrome, firefox, and safari on macos.

Fixes #457

Add resources download button + click to download picker in replay (#469)

Fixes #467 
- Add a download button on the resource page for each entry to allow
downloading each resource no matter what type.
- Add a new 'click to download' image or media picker that allows
highlighting + clicking on image/media to download on the page (to get
around 'Save Image As...) not working. Also supports inline svgs +
background images - should work better than Save Image As...
- Location bar shows a popup indicating in 'click to download' mode,
which can be canceled. Otherwise, mode remains until user downloads
something.
- Type fixes: Untangle Page and URLResource types for better type
checking.
- Deps: bump to wabac.js 2.25.1 for new download mode support

v2.5.0 (#527)

Closes https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/issues/523, closes
https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/issues/396, closes
https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/issues/470, closes

## Changes

https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/521
- Adds public `navigateReplayTo` method in `<replay-app-main>` that
allows embeds to control replay navigation directly without reloading
entire UI.
- Enables reloading `<wr-coll-replay>` iframe even if source URL hasn't
changed.
- Refactors lifecycle events to prevent unnecessary re-renders.

https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/524
- Fixes incorrect page count shown
- Enables non-seed pages by default
- Improves UX and accessibility of scrolling to load more by displaying
help text

https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/525
- Updates general styles and icons throughout to match Browsertrix
styles
- Allows deep customization of components with `part` and `exportparts`

https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/526
- Enables importing Shoelace (ie Bootstrap) icons as inline SVG
- Updates location bar buttons to use Bootstrap icons
- Replaces deprecated raw-loader with Webpack-native asset rule

https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/529
- Allows hiding collection metadata in embed.
- Moves non-seed toggle next to search bar to match resources controls
and enable hiding entire column when metadata is hidden.

https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/533
- Fix non-seed pages toggle

https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/535,
https://github.com/webrecorder/replayweb.page/pull/534
- Upgrade to Node 22 and Yarn 4
